issues.issue: Does the fresh affidavit meet the rule 351 special-circumstances tests (reasonable diligence, credibility, practically conclusive)?
issues.applicant_position: Crown says the affidavit on post-hearing US terrorism-waiver changes answers Phelan J.'s finding and should be admitted.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents say the material could have been raised earlier, is incomplete, and is not practically conclusive of the appeal.
issues.result_quote: I am not persuaded that the fresh evidence is “practically conclusive” of the appeal

issues.issue: Should the evidence be admitted in the interests of justice even if the tests are not met?
issues.applicant_position: Crown says the affidavit merely updates evidence already before Phelan J. and bears on the Article 33 question.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents say admitting it would require cross-examination, more evidence and an adjournment, making the Court a fact-finder.
issues.result_quote: The interests of justice would not be served by further complicating an already complex record
